description: Check a children's product lab test report before the importer certifies. Pass the report PDF or image as file (upload or public https download_url), or paste its text as text. Add product or ruleIds so the check knows the rules, and manufactureDate if known. Scores gaps: a rule the report does not cite, a failed result, a lab CPSC does not accept for that test, a test before the lab's acceptance, an old ASTM F963 edition, and missing or wrong dates. Returns a readiness score, each gap with how to fix it, and draft values for the CPSC eFiling certificate fields. It never says a filing is correct.

examples.text:
TEST REPORT
Report No.: VNHN2603020412
Date: Mar 20, 2026
Sample Description: Painted wooden stacking toy
Style No.: WS-12
Date of Testing: Mar 02, 2026 to Mar 18, 2026
Testing Lab: BAY AREA COMPLIANCE LABORATORY CORP. VIETNAM
CPSC Lab ID: 99999
Test Result Summary
1. 16 CFR 1303 Lead in paint and similar surface coatings PASS
2. CPSIA Section 101 Total lead content in substrate PASS
3. 16 CFR 1501 Small parts FAIL

file.description: The lab test report (a text PDF, image, or .txt file upload or public https URL).

download_url.description: Public https URL or temporary link to the report file.

labId.description: The lab's CPSC lab ID, when the report does not show it

manufactureDate.description: When the goods were made, YYYY-MM-DD

product.description: What the product is and who it is for, such as "plush toy for ages 3+", so missing rules can be found

ruleIds.description: Rule ids from find_cert_rules, instead of product

text.description: The report text, when the user pasted it instead of uploading a file

name: check_lab_report

as_of.description: ISO 8601 time the data was published by its source or fetched from it. A cached answer keeps the time of its fetch.

source.description: Who the data comes from, to cite and to check it against.

title: Check a lab report
